name: Quran Haven book identity v2

source.intent: New original logo-brand raster; one generated base and one targeted refinement.
source.inputs: No external reference or publisher/creator logo. The refinement uses only the first original generated image.

visualInspection.subject: Centered bold open book with blank ivory pages and restrained gold cover/spine; no text, Arabic, verse-like marks, other brand or watermark visible.
visualInspection.observedStyle: Crisp broad silhouette with slight residual color texture in the tool's returned image. The requested flat colors were not programmatically repainted.
visualInspection.meaningfulGeometryMeasurement: Inspection-only threshold R>80 separates ivory/gold geometry from emerald background; maximum radial extent 358.79px is within the 383.17px Android 66/108dp safe radius on the 1254px master.
visualInspection.approval: Visual source inspected; independent design/store approval remains pending.

platformOperations: Uniform resizing, output-format/sRGB metadata, and ordinary store-feature typography/compositing only. No hand redraw, semantic image edit or background removal.
initialPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original Quran Haven app, website, PWA and store icon master.
Primary request: a calm, premium, unmistakable open Mushaf/book symbol, designed as a professional small-size app identity, separate from any creator or publisher logo.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed square, truly opaque, perfectly solid deep emerald background (#146e5c). No rounded corners or border on the master.
Subject: one centered, bold open-book silhouette with broad warm ivory pages (#f7f2e7), a restrained warm-gold structural spine/cover accent (#d8c995), and graceful arch-like negative space in its book geometry suggesting sanctuary. No separate mosque, arch scene, crescent, stars or extra objects.
Style/medium: original flat vector-like raster mark, crisp clean curves, broad filled forms, high contrast, balanced symmetrical proportions, precise antialiasing. Not a photograph, 3D object or mockup.
Composition/framing: square master, centered; all meaningful book geometry must fit inside a centered circular safe zone whose DIAMETER is about 60% of the canvas (roughly 614 pixels in a 1024-pixel square). This is a circular adaptive-icon safe zone, not a square bounding box. Preserve ample plain emerald around every edge. The book must remain recognizable at 24–48px through its broad silhouette, not fine lines.
Text: none whatsoever. Pages must be blank with no writing, no Arabic characters, no invented verse-like marks, no letters, no numbers, no title, no watermark.
Constraints: no gradients, texture, grain, lighting, drop shadow, tiny page lines, decorative filigree, hands, device frame, baked icon corner mask, trademarks, publisher marks or another brand. Deliver one polished original square icon.
refinementPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand / precise-object-edit.
Input image: the original generated Quran Haven open-book icon; this is the edit target.
Make one precise refinement only: retain the existing book silhouette, symmetry, two blank pages, gold cover/spine shapes and overall identity, but render it as strictly flat, solid-color logo artwork and fit it comfortably within the adaptive-icon circular safe zone.
Use a perfectly uniform, opaque full-bleed emerald background (#146e5c), flat warm ivory page fills (#f7f2e7), and flat restrained gold (#d8c995). Remove all visible texture, grain, mottling, shading and gradients from these three color areas. No programmatic-looking page lines or added details.
Keep the book centered and reduce its total scale slightly, about 15%, so all meaningful colored book geometry including the lower outside cover corners fits inside a central circle whose diameter is about60% of the square. Keep ample plain emerald around it.
Do not change the book design, add a separate arch/mosque/crescent/star, introduce text, Arabic characters, letters, verses, numbers, watermark, frame, baked rounded corners, shadows, 3D perspective or another brand. Blank pages are mandatory. Output one crisp opaque square master icon.
